blocking_focus: Complete the candidate-bound Tester MCP state matrix.

preservation_constraints.requirement: Keep frozen technical baseline `clean_boot` passing. Do not treat this as a mandate to preserve the same visible asset, map, HUD family, or material choice if a higher-quality replacement is available and the PRD still fits.

task_specification.objective: Restore a legal 30–45 second spawn-to-Alpha encounter with collision-safe distributed enemies, then deliver upright, rifle-correct enemy motion and lifecycle bindings that make uninterrupted 3/5/10 progression and the animation matrix testable while preserving the intact Standoff environment and accepted combat shell.

diagnosis.root_cause: The remaining failures share two authority-boundary defects. Encounter topology currently chooses and applies a provisional spawn/Alpha pair without proving that ordinary traversal reaches legal Alpha before locked Bravo, while combat movement can project distinct engagement indices onto insufficiently separated navigation positions and delays crowd resolution until after an initial attack. Separately, enemy presentation attaches an M4 but maps aim/fire/reload to pistol clips, and roster initialization aims the CharacterBody3D root directly at an elevated objective, allowing pitch to enter the navigation root. These require route/reservation and transform/animation-binding repairs, not another coordinate or rotation tuning pass.

stop_conditions: Do not modify, duplicate, extract, reposition, or replace authored Standoff child meshes, native streets, materials, or the single intact environment instance; route repair is limited to product-owned outer datum, navigation, collision, spawn, objective, and route bindings.
Stop and report a concrete blocker if a legal capsule-clear spawn-to-Alpha route cannot be established on the intact authored navigation surface without asset surgery or proxy roads/floors.
Do not claim either gap closed from source presence, telemetry, a single screenshot, or a route-blocked matrix; formal closure requires fresh GameLoop Runtime and Tester evidence.

Stop validation on any candidate-script error, failed clean boot, lost mouse capture, broken movement/fire/reload/F6 behavior, persistent recoil offset, new authored-geometry occupancy, HUD obstruction, or regression of the preserved map, clouds, directional flare, AK-74M viewmodel, Settings state, or CombatFeedbackMatrix.
Do not pull deferred HUD, audio/VFX, bomb-finale, performance, or visual-density findings into implementation tasks; patrol them only for regressions attributable to these changes.

Do not replace the current humanoid or weapon package merely because a binding is wrong. Inspect and repair the adapter/state mapping first; replacement is allowed only if candidate-bound inspection proves whole-package incompatibility, and then replaces the intact package.

strategy.rationale: Use a materially different root-cause strategy from prior transform tuning: first make authored-route identity and runtime slot ownership authoritative, including fail-closed projection and occupancy; then separate upright navigation-root yaw from presentation aim pitch and bind the equipped weapon family to compatible animation states. This removes the route dependency that blocks later encounter evidence while retaining the accepted map and combat assets.

code: Developer runs the candidate's Godot import/parse and clean-boot checks after each bounded surface change; zero candidate-script errors, invalid resources, missing clips, broken signal bindings, or scene-tree transform warnings are permitted.

Inspect the route transaction and reservation invariants: semantic Alpha identity, connected ordered corners, capsule-clear anchors, unique post-projection reservations, stable IDs, atomic restore rejection, and no mutation of the authored environment subtree.

Audit every M4 semantic binding for weapon-family compatibility and verify navigation-root rotation ownership is yaw-only; confirm death shutdown ordering and lifecycle reset paths are explicit in source and runtime state.
After active callbacks for traversal, acquisition, firing, impact, kill, capture, F6, checkpoint, Replay, and Home/new mission, re-read late runtime errors; clean boot alone is insufficient.
runtime: GameLoop Runtime and Tester recapture fresh deployment with authoritative gameplay time, captured mouse, enabled input, early/middle/late route samples, and first legal Alpha overlap. The receipt must identify Alpha, show no premature Bravo overlap, report a capsule-clear corner chain, and measure 30–45 seconds from first movement.

Capture continuous Alpha search/combat samples for all three stable IDs, including positions, reserved/projected targets, safe velocity, nearest-neighbor distance, grounded support, full-capsule occupancy, route role, target visibility, and causal shot state.
